feedback: The build and prerendering pipelines, SEO metadata, and most of the core page functionality pass the existing test suite, but several UI and behavior requirements are not satisfied. The "How we work" steps layout, pillar title styling, scroll/focus handling after navigation, hash navigation behavior, and consistent contact form field styling (including the required tags) are either missing or incomplete. Additionally, the footer still contains an extra empty paragraph, violating the spec. Implement the missing CSS rules, adjust the Footer component to remove the extra paragraph, add the appropriate classes and styles for pillar titles, and ensure ScrollManager correctly handles focus and scrolling as described. Once these issues are fixed, the acceptance tests and the full checklist of requirements should pass.
unproven: Missing styling for pillar card titles: Requirements R37–R38 demand a dedicated class for pillar card titles matching the serif font and spacing of other card titles. The source code currently does not define or apply such a class, causing the pillar titles to inherit generic styles rather than the specified typography. Define a class (e.g., .pillar-title) with font-family: var(--font-serif), appropriate margin and color, and ensure it is used in the pillar card markup.

Footer still contains extra tagline paragraph: Requirement R36 requires removal of the repeated tagline paragraph from the footer. The current Footer component still includes an empty

element after rendering FOOTER_LINE, which results in an extra blank paragraph element in the DOM and fails the UI expectation that only the specified content appears. Remove the extraneous

element (or its whitespace) so the footer contains only the wordmark, the one‑line tagline, the navigation links, and the copyright text.
